fluff.overview: Clan mechanized tracked Points move five warriors in tracked APCs for all-terrain mechanized operations. Tracked vehicles handle the widest range of ground conditions, making these Points the most reliable mechanized infantry for garrison duty on worlds with varied or hostile terrain. Clan commanders assign tracked Points to sectors where wheeled or hover transport would struggle, and the armored carriers provide meaningful protection during transit. These formations anchor defensive positions and provide the mobile reserve that lighter Clan infantry elements lack.
